pool.text: Bandung granted municipal status (gemeente) establishing local government.
Construction of the regional military headquarters in Bandung.
Pont designed buildings for the first technical university, now ITB.
Completion of the ITB Rectorate Building designed by Schoemaker.
Opening of Hotel Preanger, a landmark hospitality venue.
Villa Isola completed, showcasing native architectural elements.
Deadly tornado struck Rancaekek, destroying homes and trees.
Albert Aalbers designed the modernist DENIS bank building.
Renovation of the historic Savoy Homann Hotel completed.
Indonesia's independence spurred rapid urbanization and population growth in Bandung.
Indonesian forces set fire to southern Bandung during withdrawal.
First Asian-African Conference hosted by President Sukarno in Bandung.
City boundary expanded under the Greater Bandung plan.
Awarded as Indonesia's least polluted city.
Garbage slide buried Kampung Gajah, causing over a hundred deaths.
Partial Asian-African Conference held in Bandung with world leaders.
Residents began directly voting for the mayor of Bandung.
Bandros tourist bus service launched for city visitors.
Bandung joined UNESCO Creative Cities Network.
Redevelopment of Husein Sastranegara International Airport completed.
